domain-information: A Customer Service Representative opens a new account for a client and registers it in the banking system.
A Customer Service Representative updates a client’s personal information when documentation is provided.
A Loan Officer reviews a client’s loan application with its supporting financial documents.
A Loan Officer evaluates creditworthiness and forwards the application to the risk analyst.
A Loan Officer notifies the client of the loan decision once all internal reviews are completed.
A Risk Analyst performs a credit risk assessment of the application using income data and the client’s account history.
A Risk Analyst analyzes account patterns and reports suspicious transactions to the compliance officer.
A Risk Analyst sends approval of the loan request to the loan officer to confirm the risk level is acceptable.
A Compliance Officer investigates flagged transactions to ensure adherence to regulatory requirements.
A Compliance Officer files a compliance report and shares findings with the branch manager.

domain objects.name: Customer Service Representative
domain objects.description: Handles client onboarding, account management, and documentation.

domain objects.name: Client
domain objects.description: Bank customer with one or more accounts.

domain objects.name: Client Documentation
domain objects.description: Documents submitted by the client for account or loan processing.

domain objects.name: Loan Officer
domain objects.description: Reviews loan applications and communicates decisions to clients.

domain objects.name: Loan Application
domain objects.description: Formal request from a client for credit, including supporting documents.

domain objects.name: Risk Analyst
domain objects.description: Evaluates creditworthiness and monitors account risk.

domain objects.name: Pattern Analysis
domain objects.description: Analysis of account activity to detect unusual patterns.

domain objects.name: Loan Decision
domain objects.description: Outcome of the loan review process.

domain objects.name: Credit Risk Assessment
domain objects.description: Assessment of potential credit risk for a loan application.

domain objects.name: Loan Request Approval
domain objects.description: Risk analyst approval indicating loan can proceed.

domain objects.name: Suspicious Transaction Report
domain objects.description: Report of potentially suspicious account activity.

domain objects.name: Compliance Officer
domain objects.description: Ensures bank operations comply with regulations.

domain objects.name: Compliance Report
domain objects.description: Summary of compliance investigations and findings.

domain objects.name: Branch Manager
domain objects.description: Oversees branch operations and receives compliance updates.

associations.description: Customer Service Representative records Account in Banking System.
Client provides Client Documentation.
Customer Service Representative verifies Client Documentation.
Customer Service Representative creates Account for Client.
Client submits Loan Application.
Loan Officer reviews Loan Application.
Loan Officer forwards Loan Application to Risk Analyst.
Risk Analyst performs Credit Risk Assessment for Loan Application.
Credit Risk Assessment uses Client Account for evaluation.
Credit Risk Assessment evaluates Loan Application.
Risk Analyst sends Loan Request Approval to Loan Officer.
Loan Request Approval informs Loan Officer of risk decision.
Loan Officer issues Loan Decision to Client.
Loan Decision notifies Client.
Risk Analyst performs Pattern Analysis on Account.
Pattern Analysis examines Account for irregularities.
Risk Analyst creates Suspicious Transaction Report.
Compliance Officer reviews Suspicious Transaction Report.
Compliance Officer generates Compliance Report.
Compliance Report informs Branch Manager.
